title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Payment-Effort Points in Hardship Assistance
content:
**Clause.** On an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account whose hardship approval is in force, payment-effort points are added to the hardship assistance percentage according to the patient-payment entries posted on the account fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date:

- at least 4 entries add 3 points;
- at least 1 but fewer than 4 entries add 1 point;
- no entry adds none.

**What counts as an entry.** Each patient-payment entry on the account's ledger counts once; a patient payment spread over two charges appears as two entries and counts twice. Secondary-payer payments and adjustments are not patient-payment entries.

**Window.** An entry counts when it was posted fewer than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date; one posted 12 whole months before does not.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)

| Patient-payment entries in the window | Judgement | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | no entry | 0 |
| 1 | at least 1, fewer than 4 | 1 |
| 3 | at least 1, fewer than 4 | 1 |
| 4 | at least 4 | 3 |
| 7 | at least 4 | 3 |

The points are added to the assistance percentage itself and never applied as a discount of their own.
